seoTitle: Dr Nisarg Patel - Silver Touch Hospital
html:
Qualification
Orthopedist,Sport medicine Specialist.

Dr. Nisarg Patel is a Orthopedist,Sport medicine Specialist. He has completed his master of orthopaedic surgery (M.S. ortho)from V.S. hospital, gujarat university . He has done his fellowship in arthroscopy and sports medicine from Mumbai, pune and banglore. He is specialised in complex trauma,key hole and minimal invasive surgery.
